lines.t: Worn down in this wilderness
Where the struggle never ends
No more righteous than the ones
Who never reached the promised land
I see their failings in my own
And wonder how I’ll ever stand
Your Word lifts my eyes again
I will never be enough alone
But in Your strength, I stand
You are enough
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
I can do, I can do, allll things
Your spoken Word reminds me
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
In Your strength, I stand
The flesh continues its pull on me
And my failures are all I see
Accusations torment my soul
And I don’t know how to let go
Yet even here, I see Your outstretched hands
Your blood poured out to cover all I lack
Your grace is sufficient for me
By Your strength alone I stand
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
I can do, I can do, allll things
Your spoken Word reminds me
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
In Your strength, I stand
I’m not enough, not enough, not enough
You’re enough, You’re enough, You’re enough
I’m not enough, not enough, not enough
You’re enough, You’re enough, You’re enough
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
I can do, I can do, allll things
Your spoken Word reminds me
I can do, I can do, I can do all things
Through Messiah, who strengthens me
In Your strength, I stand
You began this faith in me
You are its completion
Author and finisher
Beginning and the end
What You started here within me
You will carry to the end
Your zeal will carry me to the end
